conditions: task is difficult, blocked, unfamiliar, high-impact, or external/current knowledge materially improves the result

strategy.first: reuse installed plugin/connector/capability matching the need
strategy.second: official documentation and authoritative web sources
strategy.pattern: 7x7 advisor matrix, up to 49 useful independent evidence/advisor slots; stop early when evidence converges and more sources add no material value
strategy.acquire: reuse -> install/connect with owner action when required -> adapt -> isolated verify -> execute
